coverage.main: Read the ninety-seven-page arXiv 1911.05268 review (attack taxonomy, attacks, defenses, discussion and references). Sections were read for original experiments and transfer results; the transfer sections summarise prior work.
coverage.excluded_results: The only original experiment located is Table 4 (Section on JSMA variants): white-box JSMA, NT-JSMA and M-JSMA on correctly classified MNIST, Fashion-MNIST and CIFAR-10 test instances, evaluated on the attacked model itself. All transferability discussions and numbers summarise other works.

f1.evidence: No transfer evaluation exists; Table 4 is white-box.

f2.evidence: White-box attacks were run on correctly classified test instances, recorded as setup evidence; no transfer denominator exists.

f3.evidence: No source-to-target transfer step in original experiments.

f5.evidence: JSMA parameters (|theta| = 1, epsilon = 1) apply to white-box L0 attacks.

artifact_checks.result: Downloaded and hashed; a review article with no transfer artifact.

limitations: Retained in the frozen corpus with non-applicability reasons, as for ranks 11 and 18 (surveys).
Non-blind evidence audit; the 97-page text was read for original experiments rather than for its summaries of prior results.
